CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_memory_provenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF ROW(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.owner_user_id,NEW.scope_kind,NEW.scope_id,NEW.memory_kind,
         NEW.source_thread_id,NEW.source_message_id,NEW.source_run_id,
         NEW.source_authorization_snapshot,NEW.origin,NEW.created_by,NEW.created_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM
     ROW(OLD.tenant_id,OLD.owner_user_id,OLD.scope_kind,OLD.scope_id,OLD.memory_kind,
         OLD.source_thread_id,OLD.source_message_id,OLD.source_run_id,
         OLD.source_authorization_snapshot,OLD.origin,OLD.created_by,OLD.created_at) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'memory provenance is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

constraints.def:
CHECK (((source_authorization_snapshot IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(source_authorization_snapshot) = 'object'::text) AND (source_authorization_snapshot ?& ARRAY['actorId'::text, 'tenantId'::text, 'deploymentId'::text, 'authGeneration'::text, 'roles'::text, 'scope'::text, 'capturedAt'::text]) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot - ARRAY['actorId'::text, 'tenantId'::text, 'deploymentId'::text, 'authGeneration'::text, 'roles'::text, 'scope'::text, 'capturedAt'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'actorId'::text) = owner_user_id) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'actorId'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'tenantId'::text) = tenant_id) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'tenantId'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'deploymentId'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'deploymentId'::text) <> ''::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN ((jsonb_typeof((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'authGeneration'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'authGeneration'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'::text)) THEN (((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'authGeneration'::text))::numeric <= ('9223372036854775807'::bigint)::numeric)
    ELSE false
END AND (jsonb_typeof((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'roles'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'roles'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['["user"]'::jsonb, '["admin"]'::jsonb, '["admin", "user"]'::jsonb])) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'scope'::text) =
CASE scope_kind
    WHEN 'user'::text THEN jsonb_build_object('kind', 'user')
    WHEN 'bot'::text THEN jsonb_build_object('kind', 'bot', 'bot_id', scope_id)
    WHEN 'thread'::text THEN jsonb_build_object('kind', 'thread', 'thread_id', scope_id)
    ELSE NULL::jsonb
END) AND (jsonb_typeof((source_authorization_snapshot -> 'capturedAt'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'capturedAt'::text) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN pg_input_is_valid((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'capturedAt'::text), 'timestamp with time zone'::text) THEN (((source_authorization_snapshot ->> 'capturedAt'::text))::timestamp with time zone <= created_at)
    ELSE false
END)))
constraints.name: memories_source_authorization_shape
